dedupe_keys.name: grid to grid model estimates of daily mean river flow for gauged catchments in great britain 1891 to 2015 observed driving data marius g2g oudin daily

description: UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology publishes MaRIUS-G2G-Oudin-daily, a long reconstruction for drought and water-scarcity research in Great Britain. The dataset contains daily mean river flow in cubic metres per second for 260 catchments, spanning 1891–2015. Grid-to-Grid model runs use CEH-GEAR rainfall and potential evaporation calculated from temperature with the Oudin method. Locations correspond to National River Flow Archive gauging stations. EIDC provides CSV files and documentation under its UKCEH Click-Through Licence. The licence permits royalty-free personal or internal business use but restricts redistribution and commercial derivative services. Account-based file access was not exercised. A limitation is that the reconstructed series inherits uncertainty from meteorological inputs and model structure; it must not be described as 125 years of measured discharge at every station. The data could supply long baseline inflows for water-supply reliability and drought simulations. It complements the MORECS-driven MaRIUS series with a longer period and a different evaporation estimate.
